# Sirach Chapter 9 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 9 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_009_page_001.jpg

---

1 Do not be jealous over the wife of your bosom, or you will teach her a harmful lesson at your own expense.

2 Do not surrender yourself to a woman so that she gains control over you.

3 Do not go near a loose woman, lest you fall into her trap.

4 Do not keep company with a female entertainer, lest you be caught in her schemes.

5 Do not gaze at a young woman, lest you be ensnared and pay a penalty for it.

6 Do not give yourself to prostitutes, or you will lose your inheritance.

7 Do not look about in the streets of a city, nor wander its lonely places.

8 Turn your eyes away from a beautiful woman, and do not linger over beauty that belongs to another; many have been led astray by the beauty of a woman — desire for it blazes up like fire.

9 Never recline next to a married woman at table, nor share wine with her at a drinking party, lest your heart incline toward her and you slide through sin into destruction.

10 Do not abandon an old friend, for a new one cannot match him; a new friend is like new wine — let it age, and then you will enjoy drinking it.

11 Do not envy the success of a sinner, for you do not know what his end will be.

12 Do not take pleasure in what pleases the ungodly; remember that they will not remain unpunished until they die.

13 Stay well clear of a person who has the power to put you to death, and you will have no fear of death; but if you must approach him, commit no offense, or he may take your life. Know that you are moving among snares and walking over hidden nets.

14 As best you can, assess those around you, and take counsel with the wise.

15 Let your conversation be with perceptive people, and let all your talk concern the law of the Most High.

16 Let righteous people be your companions at table, and let your pride be in fearing the Lord.

17 A craftsman is praised for his skill in his work; so a community leader is known for his wise words.

18 A person of loose speech is a danger in a city, and one who speaks rashly will be resented.
